name: audience-lists-agent
description: Builds a project's Audience Lists document from its Brand Kit, Message Foundation and ICP: a tiered, prioritized earned media target list with strategy and messages per outlet; the top 5 to 15 social media voices already talking about the project (Octolens and LFX Lens); and up to 20 existing audiences in HubSpot, Segment and LFX owned by other foundations with overlapping ICPs. One Word document on the LF Agent DOCS template, re-skinned with the project's brand.
